Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, c As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Select Case which
    Case 0: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 1: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 2: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 3: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 4: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 5: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 6: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 7: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 8: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 9: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 10: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 11: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 12: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 13: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 14: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 15: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 16: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 17: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 18: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 19: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 20: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 21: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 22: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 23: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 24: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 25: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 26: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 27: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 28: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 29: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 30: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 31: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(109, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 32: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(61, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 33: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 34: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 35: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 36: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 37: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 38: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 39: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 40: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 41: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    End Select
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 4
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 2
    Case 5
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 16
    Case 6
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 17
    Case 7
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 0
    Case 8
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 1
    Case 9
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Spacing = 5
    Case 10
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Spacing = -1
    Case 11
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 2: sh.TextFrame2.Column.Spacing = 5
    Case 12
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Spacing = 5: sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 2
    Case 13
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Spacing = 0
    Case 14
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 2
    Case 15
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Spacing = 5
    Case 16
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 2
    Case 17
        sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 2: sh.TextFrame2.MarginLeft = 3
    Case 18
        sh.TextFrame2.MarginLeft = 3: sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number = 2
    Case 19
        sh.Callout.Type = 3
    Case 20
        sh.Callout.Gap = 5
    Case 21
        sh.Callout.Border = msoFalse
    Case 22
        sh.Callout.Accent = msoTrue
    Case 23
        sh.Callout.Angle = 2
    Case 24
        sh.Callout.AutoLength = msoFalse
    Case 25
        sh.Callout.Drop = 5
    Case 26
        sh.Callout.PresetDrop 1
    Case 27
        sh.Callout.CustomLength 5
    Case 28
        sh.Callout.AutomaticLength
    Case 29
        sh.Callout.CustomDrop 5
    Case 30
        sh.Callout.Type = 3
    Case 33
        sh.SetShapesDefaultProperties: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    Case 34
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sh.SetShapesDefaultProperties: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    Case 35
        sh.Line.Weight = 3: sh.SetShapesDefaultProperties: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    Case 36
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sh.SetShapesDefaultProperties: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    Case 37
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sh.SetShapesDefaultProperties: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    Case 38
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sh.SetShapesDefaultProperties: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddLine(20, 70, 120, 110)
    Case 39
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sh.SetShapesDefaultProperties: Set c = wb.Worksheets.Add.Shapes.AddShape(1, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    Case 40
        sh.TextFrame.Characters.Text = "Hi": sh.TextFrame.Characters.Font.Bold = True: sh.SetShapesDefaultProperties: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    Case 41
        sh.TextFrame.MarginLeft = 3: sh.SetShapesDefaultProperties: Set c = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    End Select
    s = "ok"
Measured:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.TextFrame2.Column.Number
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.TextFrame2.Column.Spacing
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.TextFrame2.Column)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.TextFrame2.Column.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.Callout)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.Gap
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.Border
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.Accent
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.Angle
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.AutoAttach
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.AutoLength
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.Drop
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.DropType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.Length
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.AutoShapeType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = c.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = c.Line.Weight
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = c.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = c.TextFrame.MarginLeft
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = c.TextFrame.Characters.Font.Bold
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Measured
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 41
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
